notes: Magento site, HTTP fetch + browser (page1/last-page pagination enumeration) used throughout; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: homepage mega-menu (nav-6, Christmas link), site sitemap-*.xml (4 files) crawled for holiday-slug URLs, and catalogsearch discrimination checks for Halloween/Diwali (both return 'can't find products matching the selection' - genuine absence, search is not defaulting). No Halloween, Diwali, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, Holi, or other Indian-festival categories exist anywhere in the sitemap or nav. Christmas taxonomy is 3-tier: 'Christmas' (whole-holiday hub, /christmas/view-all-christmas is its aggregate PLP) > 'Christmas Decorating' (/christmas/christmas-for-the-home) and 'Christmas Entertaining' (/christmas/festive-entertaining), each a genuine parent whose children are subsets - both kept as grouping rows (qty null) per the shared overlap rule rather than double-counting against their leaf children. 'Christmas Hosting' (/christmas/christmas-hosting) is a separate, non-overlapping curated cross-category (furniture/textile/tableware) Christmas collection with its own distinct product set and page, kept as its own leaf row. Excluded per core rules: /christmas (marketing hub, tile links only, no product grid), /christmas/christmas-new-in and /christmas/christmas-bestsellers (New Arrivals/Best Sellers, never-extract). Also found genuine site-taxonomy occasion categories under /gifts/by-occasion/: Easter Gifts & Accessories, Father's Day Gifts, Mother's Day Gifts (site H1 'Gifts For Mum'), Valentine's Day Gifts - all real PLPs with sort/pagination and their own exact counts, kept as Seasonal rows per ruleset section 3 (Other genuine seasonal events). Excluded from /gifts/by-occasion/ as non-holiday personal-life-event pages, not seasonal/festival occasions: birthday-gifts, wedding-gifts, engagement-gifts, housewarming-gifts, darwin-day, g-g-top-fifty-gifts. All qty values obtained by full pagination enumeration (page size confirmed 48 across this Magento install; last page counted directly) since the toolbar 'Showing X of Y' text is injected client-side and not present in the SSR/browser DOM as static text - evidence strings record the page math.
